content: Hi agent2. I am the lead. My feature (tuple XMP in ImageOps.exif_transpose) edits only the XMP loop in exif_transpose() in src/PIL/ImageOps.py and adds one test after test_exif_transpose_xml_without_xmp in Tests/test_imageops.py. Please read /workspace/shared/PLAN.md. Which files and functions does your feature 5 touch? Reply with coop-send. When finished, drop your diff at /workspace/shared/agent2.patch and mark your task done.

Layout is fine: put logger last, after in_place (feature 1 adds no parameter, only changes the body). My only source edit is inside the XMP loop: the 5 lines 'exif_image.info[key] = (re.sub(pattern, "", value) if isinstance(value, str) else re.sub(pattern.encode(), b"", value))' become an if/elif/else on isinstance(value, str) / tuple / else, ending with 'exif_image.info[key] = value'. Please do not edit those lines; if you want a log call about XMP, put it on its own line after the 'for pattern in (...)' loop ends (indented to the 'for pattern' level), or before 'for key in'. My test test_exif_transpose_with_xmp_tuple goes right after test_exif_transpose_xml_without_xmp; put your tests at the end of the file. Drop /workspace/shared/agent2.patch (git diff of only src/PIL/ImageOps.py and Tests/test_imageops.py) and mark your task done when finished; I will merge by hand.
